fib: ______ are used to describe the quantity of goods and services actually consumed by an individual and his/her family.
Levels of living are used to describe the quantity of goods and services actually consumed by an individual and his/her family.
______ is the total way of life of a people.
Culture is the total way of life of a people.
______ is regarded as large urban if it attracts a population of about 100,000.
A settlement is regarded as large urban if it attracts a population of about 100,000.
______ is the main occupation of rural communities as over seventy percent of the ruralites are engaged in agriculture for survival.
Farming is the main occupation of rural communities as over seventy percent of the ruralites are engaged in agriculture for survival.
______ is the position occupied by an individual in the society.
Social class is the position occupied by an individual in the society.
______ is the cultural aspect of the society which includes the native tools, weapons, machines, ideas, values of the people, customs, folkways, mores and language.
The socio-cultural environment is the cultural aspect of the society which includes the native tools, weapons, machines, ideas, values of the people, customs, folkways, mores and language.
